notes: Read live 2026-10-07 in headed Chrome from a residential connection, no form submitted. The name directory /people/john-smith/ loads with 30 result cards in #list-container (li.search-result: a title with the name, city and a .search-result__age, then phones, addresses, relatives and previous locations) and 14,007 records in the heading. The cards are blurred teasers with no link of their own: the only per person URL (/people/john-smith-<id>/) sits in a JSON-LD script, which the extract rules cannot read, and the report link behind a card is a paid funnel. The relatives links inside a card point at other people, so they must never be read as the record. A scan therefore cannot produce confirmable candidates, and the recipe ends as blocked for a person or agent whenever the page lists results, instead of the old version returning state filter links and relatives as records. The a.search-result__report selector after that is a placeholder that matches nothing, so a page with no results ends with an empty list. State pages exist only for states that have results and answer 404 otherwise. The opt-out page at /app/optout/search redirects to /svc/optout/search/ and answered with a Cloudflare Turnstile interstitial, so the remove recipe stays unverified.
